projects.name: Yaji
projects.summary: West African flavour meets a modern digital experience.
projects.description: A website experience for YAJI, a quick-service restaurant brand inspired by West African flavours. The design connects menu discovery, meal customisation and ordering with the brand’s story.

caseStudy.headline: Bringing West African Flavour to Modern Quick-Service Dining
caseStudy.intro: Transforming a bold culinary brand into a modern online experience that connects customers with the rich flavors and heritage of West Africa.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: YAJI is a modern quick-service restaurant brand inspired by the rich flavors of West Africa. The website was designed to showcase the brand's vibrant personality, simplify menu exploration, and create a seamless experience for customers looking to discover, customize, and order their favorite meals.

sections.title: Process
paragraphs: The design process began with understanding YAJI's brand, audience, and business goals. I explored user needs, mapped the customer journey, and structured the website around key actions such as menu discovery, customization, and ordering. These insights guided the creation of wireframes and high-fidelity designs that balance cultural storytelling with usability.

sections.title: Tools used
paragraphs: Figma · FigJam · Notion · Photoshop

sections.title: The homepage
paragraphs: The homepage was designed to make a strong first impression by immediately communicating YAJI's bold personality and unique West African food experience. The hero section combines vibrant imagery, energetic typography, and a clear call-to-action to capture attention and encourage exploration. Supporting sections highlight featured menu items, the Build Your Bowl experience, and the brand story, creating a seamless journey that guides users from discovery to engagement and ordering.

sections.title: Menu page
paragraphs: The menu page was structured to help customers browse food categories effortlessly. By organizing items into clear sections such as bowls, small chops, sides, and drinks, users can quickly find what they're looking for while enjoying an engaging visual presentation of the menu. The Build Your Bowl experience was designed to simplify meal customization while making it enjoyable. A step-by-step flow guides users through selecting their base, protein, toppings, and sauces, creating a personalized meal without overwhelming them with choices.

sections.title: About page
paragraphs: The About page was created to tell YAJI's story and highlight the inspiration behind the brand. It showcases YAJI's passion for sharing authentic West African flavors through a modern dining experience, helping visitors connect with the culture, values, and vision that make the brand unique.

sections.title: Connect page
paragraphs: The Connect page was designed to make it easy for customers, partners, and food lovers to get in touch with the brand. With clear contact options and a welcoming layout, the page encourages conversations, inquiries, and community engagement while reinforcing YAJI's approachable and vibrant personality.

sections.title: What i learned
paragraphs: Designing YAJI reinforced the importance of combining storytelling with usability. Restaurant customers don't just buy food, they buy experiences, emotions, and moments. By focusing on both brand personality and conversion, the final design delivers an experience that is visually compelling and easy to use.

projects.name: Florence San
projects.summary: A platform for leadership, growth and impact.
projects.description: A personal website redesign for Florence San, highlighting her professional expertise, community initiatives and speaking engagements. The experience creates clear paths to explore her programmes and work with her.

caseStudy.headline: Building a Digital Platform for Leadership, Growth, and Impact
caseStudy.intro: Transforming Florence San's online presence into a modern experience that communicates her vision, programs, and professional services.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Florence San is a business executive, strategy consultant, and community leader dedicated to helping individuals and organizations thrive. The project focused on redesigning her personal website to better communicate her expertise, showcase her initiatives, and create a clear pathway for visitors to engage with her work.

sections.title: Process
paragraphs: The redesign process began with understanding Florence's personal brand, audience, and key objectives. I restructured the website around her professional expertise, community initiatives, and speaking engagements, creating a more intuitive experience that makes it easier for visitors to learn about her work and take action.

sections.title: Tools used
paragraphs: Figma · FigJam · Notion · Photoshop

sections.title: The hero section
paragraphs: The hero section was designed to make a bold first impression. Oversized typography, strong visual hierarchy, and striking imagery work together to establish Florence San's presence, confidence, and influence while immediately capturing attention.

sections.title: About section
paragraphs: The About page was designed to tell Florence's story, highlighting her journey, expertise, and impact as a business leader. Through a clear narrative and thoughtful content structure, the page builds credibility while helping visitors connect with her mission and values.

sections.title: Engine fellowship section
paragraphs: The Engine Fellowship page was created to highlight a transformative leadership and growth program designed to equip participants with the skills, knowledge, and network needed to achieve their goals. The page guides visitors through the program's vision, benefits, and application process.

sections.title: 'work with me' section
paragraphs: The Work With Me section was designed to convert interest into action. By clearly outlining Florence's services, areas of expertise, and collaboration opportunities, the page helps potential clients and organizations understand how they can engage with her and take the next step.

sections.title: Thrive
paragraphs: The Thrive page showcases Florence's commitment to empowering women through mentorship, personal development, and community. The experience was designed to communicate the initiative's purpose, impact, and opportunities for involvement in a clear and engaging way.

sections.title: What i learned
paragraphs: This project reinforced the importance of bold visual hierarchy in personal branding. By simplifying the experience and giving key content room to stand out, I was able to create a website that feels confident, memorable, and aligned with Florence San's influence and impact.

projects.name: VersCoop
projects.description: I designed the VersCoop website in Figma to introduce the cooperative, explain the value of membership and make the next step easy to find. The design brings farmer ownership, practical benefits and a welcoming visual direction together.

caseStudy.headline: Putting farmers at the centre.
caseStudy.intro: A clear, welcoming home for a cooperative owned by the people it serves.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: VersCoop is a farmer-owned cooperative for tomato and pepper growers in Osun State, Nigeria. Its website introduces the organisation, explains membership and shows how shared services can support farmers.
I designed the website in Figma. The aim was to make a detailed story feel approachable: what the cooperative does, why membership matters and how someone can get involved.

sections.title: The design challenge
paragraphs: There is a lot to explain: membership, market access, shared services, governance and the people behind the cooperative. The design needed to make these ideas easy to follow without burying the main message.
The page follows a simple order: introduce the cooperative, explain the benefits, show how it works and give people a clear way to express interest.

images.alt: The story — putting the cooperative’s purpose into clear, human language.

sections.title: Lead with ownership
paragraphs: The homepage puts farmer ownership first. It gives visitors a clear idea of who the cooperative is for before asking them to explore the details.
The farmer imagery connects the message to the people it serves. Deep green, warm gold and generous spacing keep the tone welcoming and connected to agriculture.

sections.title: Break down the benefits
paragraphs: Membership benefits sit in separate, numbered blocks. Buyers, storage, pricing and training each get their own space, making a lot of information easier to scan.

images.alt: Membership — six practical benefits, each with room to breathe.

sections.title: Show the next step
paragraphs: A simple journey moves from joining to harvest, collection and market access. Clear membership links help visitors find the next step when they are ready.

images.alt: The journey — six steps from joining to profit distribution.

sections.title: Give each programme a clear purpose
paragraphs: I placed the two programmes side by side, using the same layout for each. Visitors can quickly understand the problem each programme addresses and the support it offers. Photography gives the information a human connection.

images.alt: VersGrow and VersTrace — two programmes presented in a consistent card layout.

sections.title: Make trust visible
paragraphs: Governance, leadership and surplus allocation have a place in the story. They help explain how the cooperative works and how members are represented.
Keeping this information in clear sections makes the organisation easier to understand before someone decides to join.

images.alt: Governance — a clear picture of farmer ownership and shared operations.
Timeline — separating the cooperative’s beginnings from its future ambitions.

sections.title: A smaller screen, the same story
paragraphs: The mobile view keeps the main message and membership action easy to find. The content flows vertically so visitors can explore the cooperative one section at a time.

sections.title: Make getting in touch simple
paragraphs: Contact details sit together beside a map, so visitors can choose the most familiar way to reach the cooperative. The large heading and clear grouping make this final step easy to find.

images.alt: Contact — location, phone and email gathered in one clear section.

sections.title: Design delivery
paragraphs: I designed the website in Figma. This case study includes my supplied design sections alongside a mobile capture of the live website. The thumbnail is a presentation mockup based on the homepage.

projects.name: Turbo Shine
projects.summary: Premium car care, from discovery to booking.
projects.description: A website design for TurboShine, a mobile car care service in Dubai. Clear service categories, package comparisons and calls to action make it easier to understand the offering and book a service.

caseStudy.headline: Redefining How Customers Discover Premium Car Care Services
caseStudy.intro: Designing a conversion-focused experience that highlights service quality, expertise, and convenience.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: TurboShine is a premium mobile car care service that brings professional vehicle detailing directly to customers across Dubai. The project focused on creating a modern, luxury-driven website that showcases the brand's services, builds trust, and simplifies the booking experience through clear navigation, strong visual storytelling, and conversion-focused design.

sections.title: Process
paragraphs: The design process began with understanding TurboShine's target audience, services, and premium positioning. I focused on simplifying the customer journey, organizing content around key decision points, and creating a visual experience that reflects luxury, convenience, and professionalism. These insights guided the development of a clean, conversion-focused interface that makes exploring services and booking effortless.

sections.title: Tools used
paragraphs: Figma · FigJam · Notion · Photoshop

sections.title: Hero section
paragraphs: The hero section was designed to immediately communicate TurboShine's premium car care services. Bold imagery, clear messaging, and prominent calls-to-action create trust while guiding users toward booking a service or exploring available packages.

sections.title: Services section
paragraphs: The services section was structured to help users quickly understand TurboShine's offerings. Clear categorization and visual hierarchy make it easy to compare services and find the right solution for their vehicle.

sections.title: 'why choose us' section
paragraphs: This section was designed to build credibility by highlighting TurboShine's expertise, quality standards, and customer-focused approach. Key differentiators are presented in a scannable format to reinforce trust and confidence.

sections.title: Packages & pricing section
paragraphs: The pricing section was designed to make service selection straightforward. Clear package comparisons allow customers to quickly evaluate options and make informed decisions.

sections.title: What i learned
paragraphs: This project reinforced the importance of aligning visual design with brand positioning. By combining premium aesthetics with a streamlined user journey, I learned how thoughtful design can build trust, communicate quality, and drive action without overwhelming the user.

projects.name: Sam Adeyemi - Personal Website
projects.summary: A clear digital presence for a global thought leader.
projects.description: A personal website redesign for Sam Adeyemi, built around his ideas, speaking engagements and resources. Clear content structure and strong visual hierarchy support an authoritative, accessible experience.

caseStudy.headline: Redesigning the Online Presence of a Global Thought Leader
caseStudy.intro: Crafting a modern, content-driven platform that reflects the influence, credibility, and vision of Sam Adeyemi.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: The Sam Adeyemi website was created as a digital extension of his voice, vision, and influence. The design approach emphasizes simplicity, clarity, and strong visual hierarchy to ensure his message remains the focal point. By combining thoughtful layout, refined typography, and seamless navigation, the platform delivers an experience that feels both authoritative and accessible.

sections.title: The problem
paragraphs: Sam Adeyemi’s existing digital presence did not fully reflect his global influence as a leader, speaker, and author. The experience lacked a clear structure for showcasing his work, ideas, and resources, making it difficult for users to quickly understand his value or navigate key content. There was also a need to create a more modern, cohesive interface that could better communicate authority, clarity, and purpose across all touchpoints.

sections.title: Process
paragraphs: The project began with understanding the core of Sam Adeyemi’s personal brand, his voice, audience, and the key actions users should take on the platform. From there, I structured the website to prioritize clarity and flow, ensuring users could easily navigate between his content, speaking engagements, and resources. Wireframes were developed to define layout and hierarchy, followed by a clean, modern visual direction that emphasizes readability and simplicity. Throughout the design process, decisions were guided by the need to balance storytelling with usability, resulting in a seamless experience that feels both professional and accessible.

sections.title: Tools used
paragraphs: Figma · FigJam · Notion · Photoshop

projects.name: Outlaw Original
projects.summary: A bold fashion storefront, designed and developed for Outlaw Original.
projects.description: I designed and developed Outlaw Original’s e-commerce website, bringing the fashion brand’s identity into an online shopping experience.
projects.caseImageAlt: Outlaw Original — editorial concept featuring models wearing signature Outlaw shirts

caseStudy.headline: An online home for a brand that refuses to blend in.
caseStudy.intro: I designed and developed the Outlaw Original website, combining a bold brand presence with a product-focused storefront.

sections.title: The project
paragraphs: Outlaw Original is a fashion brand with a distinct point of view. Its online store brings clothing and accessories together, from signature shirts and coordinated sets to jackets, pants and hats.
My role covered both website design and development, taking responsibility for the visual experience and the working website.

images.alt: New releases — the Outlaw Original storefront product grid.

sections.title: Brand expression & product discovery
paragraphs: The storefront pairs the brand’s confident voice with product imagery. New releases, category browsing and best sellers give visitors several ways to explore the collection.
The design brings the brand and the shopping experience together, with product names, prices and clear routes into the catalogue.

images.alt: Shop by Category — visual entry points into shirts, jackets, pants and sweatshirts.
Coming Soon — a preview of upcoming pieces in the collection.

sections.title: Design through development
paragraphs: I translated the visual design into the live e-commerce website. The WordPress and WooCommerce storefront brings together the product catalogue, category navigation and cart, alongside brand and customer-support pages.
Explore the live website to see the completed design and development work.

images.alt: The storefront footer brings together shopping categories, brand links and customer support.

projects.name: FlyMSG
projects.summary: Dashboard and onboarding redesign, with LinkedIn and Gmail plugins designed from scratch.
projects.description: An 11-month independent UI/UX design engagement: redesigning the FlyMSG dashboard and onboarding process, and designing the LinkedIn and Gmail Chrome plugins from scratch.
projects.caseImageAlt: FlyMSG dashboard design by Kenny Michael

caseStudy.headline: Redesigning the dashboard and onboarding. Designing new plugins from scratch.
caseStudy.intro: As an independent UI/UX designer, I spent 11 months working in Figma on the FlyMSG dashboard, an onboarding redesign aimed at reducing churn, and new LinkedIn and Gmail Chrome plugins.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: FlyMSG brings together AI writing, productivity and sales engagement tools. I worked on the product as an independent UI/UX designer for 11 months, using Figma.
My scope covered three areas: redesigning the dashboard, redesigning onboarding with the goal of reducing churn, and designing the LinkedIn and Gmail Chrome plugins from scratch.

sections.title: Dashboard redesign
paragraphs: I redesigned the FlyMSG dashboard. The screens bring together FlyCuts, FlyPlates, recent activity, referral rewards and usage statistics, with navigation to the wider product.

images.alt: FlyMSG dashboard with the FlyCuts navigation menu expanded.

sections.title: Subscription & account experience
paragraphs: The subscription screen groups historic usage, referral rewards, the current plan, payment details, invoices and notification settings in a single account view.

images.alt: FlyMSG subscription screen with usage breakdowns and account controls.

sections.title: Onboarding redesigned to reduce churn
paragraphs: I redesigned the onboarding process with the goal of reducing churn. The experience gives users a visible progress indicator, a way to resume onboarding and tutorial content for learning how to navigate FlyMSG.

images.alt: FlyMSG onboarding modal showing progress, a Resume Onboarding action and product tutorials.

sections.title: LinkedIn & Gmail plugins — designed from scratch
paragraphs: I designed the LinkedIn and Gmail Chrome plugins from scratch. This was new product design work, alongside the redesign of the existing dashboard and onboarding experience.

projects.name: Panar Group
projects.description: A website redesign for Panar Group, a Nigerian manufacturer of plastic pipes, packaging solutions and industrial products. Reorganised navigation and content help customers and partners explore the company’s capabilities.

caseStudy.headline: Bringing Manufacturing Excellence to the Digital World
caseStudy.intro: A complete website redesign for Panar Group, focused on showcasing its leadership in industrial manufacturing, plastic pipes, and packaging solutions through a modern and intuitive digital experience.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Panar Group is a leading Nigerian manufacturer specializing in plastic pipes, packaging solutions, and industrial products. The project involved redesigning the company's website to better communicate its capabilities, strengthen its digital presence, and create a more modern experience for customers, partners, and stakeholders.

sections.title: The problem
paragraphs: While Panar Group had built a strong reputation in the manufacturing industry, its website did not effectively reflect the scale, quality, and professionalism of the brand. Complex navigation, outdated visuals, and fragmented content made it difficult for visitors to explore the company's products and services.

sections.title: Process
paragraphs: The redesign began with an audit of the existing website, competitor research, and a review of the company's content structure. I then reorganized the information architecture, simplified user journeys, and designed a modern interface that improves usability while showcasing Panar Group's products, expertise, and industry leadership.

sections.title: Tools used
paragraphs: Figma · FigJam · Notion · Photoshop
